steps.speaker: Duck
steps.content: Quack! Quack quack quack! (Darn it! I'll be back!)

Peace is finally restored. According to the evaluation done by the analysis team on the substances of the mecha armor, the ducks likely started the riot after coming into contact with the Mania-tainted weapons.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It seems the Bureau needs to be stricter with the handling of evidence contaminated by Mania.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Luckily, the riot didn't cause significant damage, but the data room was the first place the ducks attacked, and none of your work today had been backed up. In other words, I'm afraid you'll need to redo everything you've done today over the weekend.
